label: User MCP Server
title: User-Installed MCP Server
subtitle: Wraps MCP servers that have been installed by the user from the catalog. Provides dynamic tool discovery and execution for user-configured integrations.
whenToUse: Used automatically for integrations you have installed from the catalog — GitHub, Slack, Jira, etc. You do not interact with this tool directly.

methods.name: (dynamic)
methods.description: Methods come from the installed MCP server's tool manifest. Each integration exposes different tools.

mediaCaption: A user MCP tool call showing the integration name (e.g. GitHub), the action taken (e.g. create_pull_request), and the result
